content: Two install paths: (1) pip end-user: 'pip install rai-core' + 'rai-config-init' + optional apt ROS2 deps -- no colcon workspace needed for pure-Python use. (2) source/dev: clone repo, 'vcs import < ros_deps.repos' to pull rai_interfaces, 'uv sync' (uv replaced poetry as of RAI 2.0) for the Python venv, 'colcon build --symlink-install' for the ROS2 interfaces package, 'source ./setup_shell.sh'. Requires ROS2 Jazzy or Humble sourced first; Python 3.12 for Jazzy, 3.10 for Humble. Vendor (LLM backend) chosen via config.toml, edited through a Streamlit configurator ('uv run streamlit run src/rai_core/rai/frontend/configurator.py') or 'rai-config-init'; supports Ollama, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, others. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai/setup/install/, github.com/RobotecAI/rai.
